query.description: Quick Stats records matching the filters (at most 50,000 per request): one row per published value with Value, CV (%), unit_desc, year, reference period and geography.

source_desc.desc: program: SURVEY or CENSUS (Census of Agriculture, every 5 years: 2017, 2022)

sector_desc.desc: CROPS, ANIMALS & PRODUCTS, ECONOMICS, DEMOGRAPHICS, ENVIRONMENTAL

group_desc.desc: e.g. FIELD CROPS, VEGETABLES, LIVESTOCK, DAIRY, POULTRY, FARMS & LAND & ASSETS, INCOME, PRICES PAID

commodity_desc.desc: e.g. CORN, SOYBEANS, WHEAT, COTTON, CATTLE, HOGS, MILK, EGGS

class_desc.desc: e.g. ALL CLASSES, WINTER, SPRING, DURUM (wheat)

util_practice_desc.desc: e.g. ALL UTILIZATION PRACTICES, GRAIN, SILAGE

statisticcat_desc.desc: e.g. AREA PLANTED, AREA HARVESTED, PRODUCTION, YIELD, PRICE RECEIVED, INVENTORY, SALES

unit_desc.desc: e.g. ACRES, BU, BU / ACRE, $ / BU, HEAD, $, LB

short_desc.desc: the full data item, e.g. 'CORN, GRAIN - PRODUCTION, MEASURED IN BU' (most precise filter); or a catalog alias (corn_production, ...)

domain_desc.desc: TOTAL (default breakdown) or a domain such as ORGANIC STATUS, AREA OPERATED

agg_level_desc.desc: NATIONAL, STATE, COUNTY, AGRICULTURAL DISTRICT, REGION : MULTI-STATE, ZIP CODE, WATERSHED

state_alpha.desc: two-letter state code (US for national rows)

freq_desc.desc: ANNUAL, MONTHLY, WEEKLY, POINT IN TIME

reference_period_desc.desc: YEAR, MARKETING YEAR, JAN ... DEC, WEEK #nn, FIRST OF MAR, ...

count.description: Number of records a query would return (check before a large query; over 50,000 is refused).
